That night, the beam seemed to sweep a little farther across the water.", "w02": "凌晨四点，城市在沉睡与苏醒之间徘徊。路灯拖着长长的光影，空荡的街道只剩清洁工扫帚的沙沙声。远处早点铺亮起暖黄的灯，蒸汽缓缓升腾，带着面粉的香气。最后一班夜车缓缓驶过，车窗里的人靠着玻璃沉沉睡去。天边泛起一线鱼肚白，高楼的轮廓渐渐清晰，新的一天正悄悄从东方走来。", "w03": "- Recursion is when a job is solved by doing a smaller copy of the same job, like opening a set of nesting dolls.\n- Each copy keeps passing the job down to a smaller one until it reaches the tiniest doll, which is the stopping point.\n- Then the answers come back up one by one, so the big job gets finished by all the little ones."}
